description: A set-sized well-order collapses to its ordinal order type.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.MostowskiCollapse.wellOrder_collapse.{u} {α : Type u} (R : α → α → Prop) [h : IsWellOrder α R] :
  Lemmatheca.SetTheory.MostowskiCollapse.Extensional R ∧
    ∃ (hw : WellFounded R), ZFSet.range (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.MostowskiCollapse.collapse hw) = (Ordinal.type R).toZFSet
